item.title: Hoops Tourney Honors Hometown Heroes
item.description: When Joyce Furman was pulling down rebounds and piling up points on the Quinnipiac College hardwoods in the 1980s, there was no name, image, and likeness (NIL) awaiting her; no dreams of a future in the WNBA. “I never thought I would be remembered,” Furman said at the annual Robert Saulsbury Basketball Invitational. The post Hoops Tourney Honors Hometown Heroes appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: 9th Square Indoor Plant Shop Closes
item.description: Fair Haven Heights resident Bindu Vanapalli’s many hoyas, pothos, succulents, and other indoor plants in need of TLC were the last plants that Bark & Vine store manager Olivia Lynn repotted Wednesday -- as the much-loved Ninth Square shop marked its last activity on the last day of 2025. The post 9th Square Indoor Plant Shop Closes appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: 17-Year-Old Arrested For 18-Year-Old Bystander’s Murder
item.description: City police have arrested a 17-year-old from Derby for allegedly shooting and killing an innocent bystander -- 18-year-old Alexa Acevedo of Norwich -- during a downtown Halloween night shootout that also injured three others between the ages of 18 and 21. The post 17-Year-Old Arrested For 18-Year-Old Bystander’s Murder appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Sabin Steps Down As Ward 7 Alder
item.description: Less than an hour before he was set to be sworn in for a fourth term as a downtown alder, Eli Sabin announced on Thursday that he's moving to Westville and will be stepping down from the board. The post Sabin Steps Down As Ward 7 Alder appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: DEI, Democracy Embraced At Inauguration
item.description: "Diversity, inclusion, and equity are embedded in our Constitution. It's called e pluribus unum. Out of many, one." Those words were delivered by Board of Education Secretary Ed Joyner on Thursday, after he was sworn in alongside Mayor Justin Elicker, City Clerk Michael Smart, and members of the Board of Alders to a new term in office. The post DEI, Democracy Embraced At Inauguration appeared first on New Haven Independent.
